feature: Refund otomatis di jalur pembayaran manual (double payment DBP, overpayment OVP, payment di atas PS-APP)
note: Saat staff menyimpan pembayaran manual, service membuat refund notice untuk pembayaran ganda (reason DBP), kelebihan bayar (OVP), dan pembayaran atas notice PS-APP (OCMS-SR-2026-190). Story OCMS44.x tidak menyebut refund; kemungkinan dicakup story refund epic lain, belum dicek.
note_en: When staff save a manual payment, the service creates a refund notice for a double payment (reason DBP), an overpayment (OVP) and a payment over a PS-APP notice (OCMS-SR-2026-190). The OCMS44.x stories do not mention refunds; it may be covered by a refund story in another epic, not checked.

feature: Pembuatan nomor receipt lokal MPY untuk pembayaran manual
note: OCMS44.4 (Removed) meminta receipt diterima dari Cumulus. Code yang mirip hanya membuat nomor receipt sendiri (MPY + sequence + checksum) dan menyimpannya di web_txn_detail.receipt_no. Tidak diklaim.
note_en: OCMS44.4 (Removed) asks for the receipt to be received from Cumulus. The similar code only generates its own receipt number (MPY + sequence + checksum) and stores it in web_txn_detail.receipt_no. Not claimed.

feature: Halaman Search Outstanding Notices (ID No., Vehicle No., Offender Name) dengan operasi batch
note: Pencarian notice outstanding per ID, Vehicle, Offender Name, tanpa menu dan tanpa link ke halaman pembayaran; checkbox dipakai untuk batch suspend/revive/furnish dan CSV. Dipakai sebagai bukti Sebagian di OCMS44.1/44.2; story pemilik aslinya (epic notice search) tidak dicek di chunk ini.
note_en: Outstanding notice search by ID, Vehicle, Offender Name, with no menu entry and no link to the payment page; checkboxes feed batch suspend/revive/furnish and CSV. Used as Sebagian evidence in OCMS44.1/44.2; its original owner story (notice search epic) was not checked in this chunk.
